# Advanced Dairy Diagnostics & Consulting, LLC (The Dairy Doctor)

## Who we are
Advanced Dairy Diagnostics & Consulting, LLC, doing business as The Dairy Doctor, is a mail-in veterinary diagnostic laboratory owned and operated by Dr. Glenn Pearson, DVM, in Frederic, Wisconsin. Founded in 1999 as Dairy Pharm Services, the practice became a BioPRYN affiliate lab in 2005, the first east of the Rockies, and serves dairy, beef, goat and sheep producers across all 48 contiguous United States.

## Services and pricing
BioPRYN blood pregnancy testing for cattle and bison costs $3.50 per test. BioPRYN blood pregnancy testing for goats and sheep costs $7.00 per test. BVD PI (persistent infection) testing, run from either a blood sample or an ear notch, costs $6.95 per animal. Herd health consulting is also available, covering Johnes disease, Bovine Leukosis and Mycoplasma monitoring, Dairy Comp 305 records consulting, and biosecurity program design. New client discounts are available on all services; ask by phone or email.

## Location
362 310th Avenue, Frederic, WI 54837, United States. This address is both the business mailing address and the address customers ship blood and ear notch samples to.

## Contact
Phone: (715) 653-2201. Fax: (715) 653-4301. Email: info@dairydoctor.com.

## How ordering works
There is no online store or checkout. Customers collect blood or ear notch samples on their own farm (a step-by-step tail-bleeding guide is published on the site), complete the PDF submission form that matches their species and test (separate forms exist for cattle/bison pregnancy testing, goat/sheep pregnancy testing, and BVD PI testing), package the samples with the completed form, and ship them by Priority Mail, FedEx or UPS timed to arrive no later than Wednesday. Samples that reach the lab by Wednesday are reported that Thursday by email, fax or phone, whichever the form marks. Phone and email support are available throughout for questions about testing or forms.
